scripts.map:fetch: cd pipeline && uv run python -m stanford_pixxel.fetch_osm && uv run python -m stanford_pixxel.fetch_stanford && uv run python -m stanford_pixxel.fetch_lidar && uv run python -m stanford_pixxel.fetch_naip
